failure_summary.description: Selected Corazon Aquino from a salient role association instead of checking which candidate fit the clue’s January 1992 candidacy details; the existing rule already requires matching distinctive details.
Repeated a bare list of monarchs instead of inferring their shared contextual relation, Spain.

patch.reasoning: The first failure is already covered by the instruction to match distinctive details rather than keywords, so no duplicate rule is needed. The bare-list instruction covers only characters and roles; broaden it to named entities whose shared relation is the implied target.

edits.target: When a prompt consists only of a list of character names or roles, use context to identify their shared work or program if that is the implied target. Return the work or program, not the performers, unless the prompt asks for the cast.
edits.content: When a prompt consists only of a list of named entities, treat it as an elliptical clue to their shared contextual relationship or category when that is implied. Use context to identify the intended link (for example, a country shared by rulers or a work shared by characters), and answer with that link rather than repeating the list. Do not invent a shared relation when context does not support one.
